verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents registrable outbound webhooks that POST to your URL when chosen events happen. There is a full CRUD API to create, list, retrieve, update and delete webhooks, plus signed payloads with a retrievable verification key, three receiver authentication methods, and automatic deactivation after sustained delivery failures. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery, and a documented event catalog and retry semantics in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks allow you to specify that we should POST to your URL when certain events happen.
Creates a webhook for the specified events.
Our webhooks service automatically signs each webhook event sent to the URL you specify in Ironclad.
it is possible to create and retrieve webhooks in the UI and through the API
Webhooks offer three authentication methods: API key, basic, and bearer token.
